capabilities: Edit LaTeX formulas as rendered math with commands finished by Space
Insert inline and display math via Ctrl+M / Ctrl+Shift+M hotkeys
Fill wrapper boxes and navigate them with Tab and arrow keys
Number and renumber display equations with \tag{n}
Insert symbols from a searchable LyX-style formula sidebar panel
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX renderer or converter; it edits formulas visually but always saves them back as plain $...$ and $$...$$ LaTeX in the note.
extras: Desktop only; created by AI (Claude Code) and directed and tested by Omer Cooper; bundles MathLive fonts so it works offline; formulas the editor can't handle (aligned, \label, multi-line blocks, unknown macros) are left as LaTeX text.
problem: Obsidian math is written and edited as raw LaTeX text, with no way to work on a formula as rendered math.

relations.evidence: The math editor is MathLive 0.111.1 (MIT), bundled with its fonts
makes typing math feel like LyX: you edit the formula as rendered math

summary: WYSIWYG math editor that lets you edit LaTeX formulas as rendered math LyX-style, with Space-finished commands, empty boxes, and equation numbering.
